_readme: This file IS the policy. Resolve's guard reads its autonomy limits from here — a merchant changes what the agent is allowed to do without touching or redeploying any code. Env vars (AUTO_REFUND_LIMIT_<CCY>, RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS, ESCALATION_FOLLOWUP_MINUTES) still win when set, for ops-level overrides during a demo or incident; this file is the source of truth everyone else sees.

INR._note: 500000 minor units = ₹5,000. Anything over this is a hard deny → escalated to a human, never approved by the brain.

_return_window_note: A physical, returnable item delivered longer ago than this without a completed return is a hard deny (return_window_expired), not a hold.
_escalation_note: How long the escalation agent waits before checking back on a ticket it raised and pinging the assignee if it's still open. Demo runs override this to a couple of minutes via ESCALATION_FOLLOWUP_MINUTES so a judge doesn't wait an hour to see the follow-up fire.
